$comment: Checkov check_id -> DISA CCI + NIST SP 800-53 mapping, ported verbatim (entry order and list order preserved) from the published @mitre/hdf-converters 2.14.0 package. Do not hand-edit entries; correct a mapping upstream and re-port.

Upstream methodology, quoted from the source file header (updated 2026-04-04): "Use `checkov --list` to get starting baseline document. Using generative AI (Opus 4.6), mapped from Checkov v3.2.506 to CIS v8 rule IDs to NIST control families to DISA CCI. Results were peer reviewed by two personnel after for completeness. Total checks mapped: 1341"
nistRevision is 5 because the table uses SR-3, which exists only at Rev 5; lookups translate to the process-wide NIST revision.

Coverage gaps: checks added to Checkov after v3.2.506 are absent and fall back to the static-analysis controls. List the current checks with `checkov --list`, compare against these keys, map the difference with the methodology above, and publish the reviewed result before re-porting.

Re-port: `npm pack @mitre/hdf-converters@<version>`, confirm the tarball matches the registry integrity (`npm view @mitre/hdf-converters@<version> dist.integrity`), load `package/lib/src/mappings/CheckovToCciAndNistMappingData.js` with Node, and write each entry of its exported `data` object into `mappings` as {cci, nist} in source order.
